_schema._file: A move catalog in the moves.json schema ({"moves": {id: move}}), merged over moves.json by id (Kanto151Data.install()). Built by tools/native/kanto151/gen.py from the main-series game data (every move each Kanto species can learn in any game), the Scarlet & Violet 151 TCG attacks and the Indigo League anime; its numbers come from kanto151_balance.json. Engine keys first, then the design's extra keys.
_schema.name: string, shown UPPERCASE
_schema.type: the move's Pokemon type (main series); its energy kind is kanto151.json type_energy (balance type_map)
_schema.energy: extra: the energy kind its typed chips draw on (type_energy of type), for display and tests
_schema.tier: opener (1 chip) | mid (2 to 3 chips) | finisher (all chips)
_schema.cost: an Array of energy kinds (a typed chip pays its own kind or a Colorless cost; colorless is paid by any chip), or a finisher {all: true, min: N, type: kind | colorless}
_schema.power: the damage power; a finisher's base power
_schema.power_per_chip: finisher only: power added per chip spent
_schema.priority: higher acts first (reactions 3 to 4, Quick Attack 1, Roar -1)
_schema.effects: tags (the engine's names where it has them: acc_down atk_down def_down def_down2 speed_down def_up evasion_up speed_up para burn sleep poison confuse drain (Leech Seed) flinch high_crit recoil trap force_out fixed_40 wind clear_field disrupt sure_hit identify break_protect); every tag is defined with its numbers in kanto151_balance.json effects
_schema.chance: 0 to 1: a damaging move's side-effect chance (null: battle_config damage.status_effect_chance)
_schema.reaction: reaction only: {trigger: any | attack | physical | special, effect: evade | block | counter (engine) | endure | guard | destiny | bounce | steal (design, for the engine to add), scope: next | turn, mult (counter), kind (the design's name), lock (chips), chance (0 to 1), reduce (guard)}
_schema.two_phase: two_phase only: {semi: underground | airborne | underwater | charging, on_commit: [tags], invulnerable (only Dig, Fly, Dive and Bounce), hit_by (the counter table's moves that reach that state), forced_out_by}
_schema.desc: one short line for the move list
_schema.rarity: extra: the tuning class of its numbers (shared moves are common; a signature move carries its owner's rarity)
_schema.signature: extra: true when only one evolution line can use it (a TCG attack, or a game move only that line learns)
_schema.owner: extra: the line's first species for a signature move
_schema.fixed_damage: extra: null, a number, level, half_hp, match_hp, user_hp or ohko (power is the engine's fallback until it reads this)
_schema.disrupt: extra: focus points the foe loses (disruption moves); install() writes these into battle_config disruption.moves
_schema.counters: extra: what the counter table (battle_config counters.rows plus balance counter_rows_extra) says about this move: hits_states, ignores_dodge, cancels_dodge, breaks_protect, foresight, forces_out_two_phase
_schema.combo: extra: {after: [move ids] | after_type | after_role | before, effect: power | enables | skip_commit | never_miss, power_pct}
_schema.power_mods: extra: the multipliers the generator applied to the tier's numbers (accuracy, priority, effects, two_phase, hits_states, role, game_power); the test recomputes power from these and the balance file
_schema.gen: extra: the game generation it debuts in
_schema.game: extra: the main-series numbers it was converted from (power, accuracy, pp, hits)
_schema.bonus_type: extra: bonus_vs_type moves, the energy kind

_skill_schema._doc: Passive skills: TCG abilities (source tcg) and main-series abilities for the rarer species (source game). owner (the first), owners, effects (tags in the balance file), desc.

_notes: TCG data: the Pokémon TCG API's Scarlet & Violet 151 set (sv3pt5, 2023), which prints every one of the 151 with current types, weakness, resistance and rarity. Older eras differ; see each species' _notes.

Game data: PokeAPI, every move each species can learn in any main-series game (level-up, TM/HM, tutor, egg). Learn levels come from the Kanto-era games first (Yellow, Red/Blue, FireRed/LeafGreen, Let's Go), then the newest game.

The TCG weakness chain is followed: Water beats Fire, Lightning beats Water, Fire beats Grass, Grass beats Fighting, Fighting beats Lightning, Darkness and Colorless, Darkness beats Psychic, Metal beats the Psychic-type fairies.
